Mod.Name: FF9 Coop
Mod.Author: Bergaffe
Mod.Description:
Co-op multiplayer (beta, 2-4 players): every party member belongs to a player and only that player controls it in battle. The second player walks around as a visible companion, can talk to NPCs, open chests, shop and play Tetra Master. Local with several controllers or online via Steam Remote Play Together / Parsec.
In-game co-op menu: K or L3+R3. English and German.
